brief: The canvas displays a slow, ethereal cosmic environment characterized by a continuous, flowing tide of translucent, overlapping circles. Throughout the stream, pointillist stars drift, maintaining a constant, subtle luminescence. When the circles and stars interact, they create momentary flares at their overlap points. These intense flares then visibly expand outward into rings of dissipating, radiating light, creating a dynamic and continuous visualization of cosmic flow and light interaction.

statement: This sketch creates an ethereal cosmic scene where translucent, overlapping circles flow slowly across the canvas, simulating a vast, continuous tide. Embedded within this stream are countless pointillist stars that subtly twinkle and interact with the circles. When stars and circles overlap, they produce momentary flares that expand into dissipating rings of light, suggesting cosmic energy interactions. The visualization is entirely self-contained, running without user input, and maintains a consistent frame rate by efficiently batching drawing operations and avoiding expensive computations per frame.
